title: Numbered list with enumerate
description: Write a function `numbered_lines(items)` that returns a list of strings formatted as '<index> <item>', starting at index 0.
hints: You need both the position and the value of each item while looping — a plain `for item in items` only gives you the value.
`enumerate(items)` gives you (index, item) pairs you can unpack directly in the for line.

result = []
for index, item in enumerate(items):
    result.append(f"{index} {item}")
return result
expected_behavior: Returns a list of formatted strings, one per item.
explanation: `enumerate()` wraps an iterable and yields (index, value) tuples, which we unpack directly into `index, item` in the for line — avoiding a manually managed counter variable.
